;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant in Libya]] during the [[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)|Libyan Civil War]]
**An attack on forces loyal to [[Field marshal (Libya)|Field Marshal]] [[Khalifa Haftar]] in [[Sabha, Libya]], kills at least nine people. [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] claims responsibility. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/nine-dead-in-is-attack-on-haftar-forces-in-south-libya/articleshow/69178531.cms (AFP via ''The Times of India'')]
*[[North Korea and weapons of mass destruction]]
**[[North Korea]] fires several short-range projectiles from the east coast city of [[Wonsan]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-05-04/north-korea-fires-short-range-missile/11080184 (Reuters/AP via ABC Australia)]
*[[Gaza–Israel clashes (May 2019)]]
**The [[Israeli Air Force]] carries out dozens of airstrikes on the [[Gaza Strip]] in response to a barrage of rockets fired by [[Hamas]] militants. The [[Turkey|Turkish]] state-owned [[Anadolu Agency]]'s media office in Gaza was among those hit by Israeli missiles, prompting outrage from Turkish officials. [https://www.dw.com/en/israel-hits-offices-of-turkish-state-news-agency-in-gaza/a-48604155 (Deutsche Welle)]
*Four [[Turkish Armed Forces|Turkish soldiers]] were killed in an attack on their base in [[Iraq]] by Kurdish forces. Twenty [[PKK|PKK members]] were also killed in the attack. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-security-soldiers/four-turkish-soldiers-killed-in-clashes-with-pkk-ministry-idUSKCN1RW07B (Reuters)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Vajiralongkorn]], [[King of Thailand]] since 2016, is officially  [[Coronation of Vajiralongkorn|crowned]] sovereign. His wife [[Suthida|Suthida Tidjai]], who he had married only three days prior, is declared Queen consort. [https://washingtonpost.com/world/2019/05/05/dressed-gold-new-thai-king-has-procession-through-bangkok-second-day-coronation-ceremonies/ (''Washington Post'')] 

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 North Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**[[Cyclone Fani]] starts affecting [[Bangladesh]], where over a million people have been evacuated from the storm's path. Authorities say the cyclone has killed at least five people in Bangladesh and damaged over a thousand homes. At least twelve people have been killed in total by the cyclone. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-cyclone/cyclone-hits-bangladesh-after-battering-india-mass-evacuations-save-lives-idUSKCN1SA05Y (Reuters)]


;Science and technology
*[[Interstellar Technologies]] successfully launches uncrewed rocket [[MOMO-3]] from its launch facility in [[Taiki, Hokkaido]], becoming the first commercially developed [[Japan]]ese rocket to reach the [[Kármán line]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/japanese-private-firm-sends-first-rocket-into-space/a-48600093 (Deutsche Welle)]

;Sport
*[[2019 Kentucky Derby]]
**In [[Thoroughbred horse racing|horse racing]], [[Country House (horse)|Country House]] wins the 145th Kentucky Derby after [[Maximum Security (horse)|Maximum Security]] is disqualified. The latter horse is the first Kentucky Derby winner ever to have been disqualified for interference. [https://www.cbssports.com/general/news/kentucky-derby-2019-results-live-updates-as-maximum-security-wins-the-145th-run-for-the-roses/ (CBS Sports)]
